title: Packages, pip, and regular expressions

spans.text: WHY USE THIS?
Packages add external capabilities and regex checks text patterns; ordinary string methods may be clearer for simple text.
CORE EXPLANATION
Install third-party packages for a project; virtual environments isolate dependencies. The re module matches text patterns.
EXAMPLE CODE
QUESTION: What will this code print? Predict first, then run it.

spans.code:
import re

match = re.search(r'\d+', 'Lesson 26')
print(match.group() if match else 'not found')

# python -m pip install package-name

spans.title: Why it matters
spans.text: Packages add external capabilities and regex checks text patterns; ordinary string methods may be clearer for simple text.

spans.title: Watch out
spans.text: A regex does not make input safe for SQL, HTML, or a URL; use context-appropriate escaping or parameters.
COMMON MISTAKES
String methods return transformed text rather than changing the original; a regex checks only the pattern you specify.
